purpose: Canonical route identity, without renaming a stored pathway id. A pathway id appears in saved matters, witness fixtures, closure rows, crosswalk adjudications and packet render jobs, so renaming one in place breaks every stored reference to it. An alias records the correct identity beside the legacy id and leaves the legacy id resolvable until no stored or generated dependency remains.
rule: A legacy id may be removed only when nothing references it. Until then both resolve, and the canonical id is the one shown to participants and used in new legal names.

aliases.reason: O.C.G.A. § 42-8-66 is not limited to youthful offenders, so the legacy id misdescribes the mechanism it was bound to. The national legal decision report of 2026-08-28 names the accurate identity.
aliases.legacyIdStillGoverns: O.C.G.A. § 42-8-62.1 first-offender restriction and sealing, contracted under LD-GA-01. The legacy pathway keeps that contract; it is a different statute and is not being renamed away.
aliases.participantFacingName: Retroactive First Offender treatment under O.C.G.A. § 42-8-66
aliases.legalName: Petition for Retroactive First Offender Treatment, Exoneration and Discharge
aliases.removalCondition: Remove the legacy id only when no saved matter, witness fixture, closure row, crosswalk adjudication or render job references it.
